invention_title: Smart dough state control using motor-current ripple, bowl temperature, and timed rest intervals
inventive_concept: Because fixed bread-maker mixing schedules cannot reliably infer dough hydration and elasticity state, the invention compares motor-current ripple, bowl temperature, and timed rest intervals to classify dough state and adjust kneading torque/rest timing, thereby reducing under-fermentation and over-mixing.

claim_elements.text: compare motor-current ripple, bowl temperature, and timed rest intervals
classify dough hydration and elasticity state from the comparison
adjust kneading torque and rest timing when the classified state crosses a threshold

delta_rows.applicant_distinguishing_feature: uses the three-signal comparison as a state-classification input rather than a single fixed schedule parameter
delta_rows.technical_effect_evidence: prototype evidence links the comparison to hydration and elasticity classification
delta_rows.claim_strategy: place the three-signal comparison in the independent claim as the sensing and classification basis
delta_rows.fallback_position: narrow to motor-current ripple plus bowl temperature if rest-interval evidence needs more support

delta_rows.applicant_distinguishing_feature: classifies hydration and elasticity state rather than only monitoring temperature, time, or appliance mode
delta_rows.technical_effect_evidence: R&D evidence states that the classified state reduces under-fermentation and over-mixing
delta_rows.claim_strategy: tie the state classifier to a concrete dough-state output and avoid result-only optimization wording
delta_rows.fallback_position: dependent claim for threshold ranges or state labels supported by experiment data

delta_rows.applicant_distinguishing_feature: changes kneading torque and rest timing in response to the classified dough state crossing a threshold
delta_rows.technical_effect_evidence: prototype logs connect state threshold crossing to changed torque/rest control
delta_rows.claim_strategy: make the control action depend on threshold crossing to distinguish from generic bread-maker control
delta_rows.fallback_position: dependent claims for torque, rest timing, and exception-handling variants
